gist: Later archival cover of the file: fond of the Дирекція императорск. т-ровъ, СПб. Контора; title as in the catalogue (fees for articles, price reductions, photographs of artists for the journal, sale in railway kiosks), 'исходящие бумаги'; ЦГАНХ stamp.
why: file cover only

date: Начато Апрѣль 1909 г. Окончено Фев. 1910 г.
gist: Lower half of the same archival cover (overlaps p.1): file begun April 1909, finished Feb. 1910; stamp with ед. хр. № 168.
why: file cover; gives the date span only

gist: Original inner title leaf of the editorial office's register: '1909 г. Исходящія бумаги'.
why: title leaf only

from_to: Редакторъ «Ежегодника» -> Александринскій театръ (Н. А. Корневу), Маріинскій театръ опера (Монахову), Маріинскій театръ балетъ (Н. Г. Сергѣеву), Контора Московскихъ Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Отпускъ, Исх. № 3-4-5 и 6: the editor sends a subscription sheet for the Yearbook 'подъ моей редакціей' to the drama, opera and BALLET troupes and to the Moscow office, asking that it be shown to the artists and that he be told who wishes to receive the Yearbook.
why: subscription drive among artists incl. the ballet troupe via Sergeyev; the new editor acting

gist: Lower part of p.4 (overlap): end of the list of addressees (ballet - Н. Г. Сергѣеву; Moscow office), the full text of the subscription-sheet request, signed 'Редакторъ'.
why: duplicate of p.4; ballet troupe named

gist: The Director had wished to entrust the editor with the 'ликвидація' of back issues of the Yearbook. A commission agent for art publications (firms Кнебель and another), Степанъ Сергѣевичъ ?ишкинъ, landowner of Романо-Борисоглѣбск. у., Ярославской губ., has offered to distribute the old issues under an agreement with the Directorate.
why: plan to sell off the back stock of earlier Yearbooks through a commission agent

gist: Lower part of p.6 (overlap), same text down to '...распространяетъ «Ежегодникъ Императорскихъ Театровъ» прежнихъ'.
why: duplicate of p.6

gist: Terms of the agent's proposal: back issues at 3 р. 50 к. per copy; the Контора posts each order cash-on-delivery and, once paid, credits the agent 1 ruble commission per copy sold; the Контора gives him sample volumes of various years. The editor thinks this a riskless way to speed the liquidation of the 'большого запаса' of Yearbooks.
why: price, commission and large unsold stock of back issues

gist: Исход. № 8: a forthcoming issue is to reproduce scenes from «Мессинская невѣста» as staged by the Измайловскій досугъ; Grand Duke Константинъ Константиновичъ consented and wished the Yearbook also to carry photographs of the exterior and interior of the Китайскій Театръ at Царское Село, where the tragedy was played in the Imperial presence. Asks permission to admit a photographer carrying the editorial office's certificate.
why: contents and illustrations decision: photographing the Chinese Theatre and the Messina Bride production

gist: Lower part of p.9 (overlap) with the close of the letter and the addressee block: 'Его Превосходительству Ф. Н. Пѣшкову' (surname faint).
why: duplicate of p.9; gives the addressee's surname

gist: Исход. № 10(?): a writ of execution (№ 1461?) is returned to the bailiff with the statement that the nobleman П. О. Бортновскій(?) was not and is not assistant editor of the Yearbook.
why: who was (not) on the editorial staff

gist: Исход. № 26: note that a reply was sent to a correspondent's letter asking for a reduction of the sale price of the Yearbook. The reply itself is not here.
why: request to lower the sale price; no figures

from_to: to Николай Васильевичъ (bottom note: Е. Прев-ву Н. В. Д...?)
gist: Исх. № 39, hasty draft with deletions, answering a letter of 5 June (№ 33): the information needed for the Yearbook is 1) the membership of the [Театрально-литературный] Комитетъ for the 1908-1909 season, 2) the number of plays it considered, 3) the titles of plays it approved for the Imperial theatres. Hand is hard; sender/recipient roles not certain (Дризенъ himself is Н. В.).
why: gathering of contents for the Yearbook (committee data for 1908-09)

gist: Исх. № 48: advertising terms in the Yearbook 'редактируемомъ мною'. Adverts go either in the middle of the text (full page 120 р., 1/2 - 70, 1/4 - 40, 1/8 - 25, 1/16 - 15) or after it (90, 50?, 30, 18, 10 р.). As the journal is published at the expense of the Imperial Court, adverts must be 'строго академиченъ'.
why: advertising rate card for the 1909 Yearbook

gist: Lower part of p.14 (overlap): the same advertising rates and the 'strictly academic' condition.
why: duplicate of p.14

gist: End of the advertising letter (blurred photo): firms connected with theatre and the arts are preferred; the journal appears 7-8 times a year (seven this year), is printed in 1500-2000 copies, costs 6 р. a year with delivery, single issue 1 р.
why: states print run (1500-2000), frequency and prices

gist: Исход. № 55: the редакція asks Glagolin to say which member of the Контора his arrangement about an exchange of publications was passed to, since nobody asked could confirm it; best to write on editorial letterhead that the редакція of the journal «Театръ Литературно-Художественнаго Общества» agrees to the exchange (continues on p.20).
why: exchange of copies with another theatre journal; no editorial content

gist: Lower part of p.17 (overlap), same text.
why: duplicate of p.17

gist: Исход. № 61, on the letterhead 'Редакція «Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ»': subject line only - 'О командировкѣ фотографа въ г. Москву'. No names of photographer or sitters.
why: photographer sent to Moscow for the Yearbook's illustrations

gist: End of the Glagolin letter: the Society's journal should declare its agreement to the exchange of publications for 1909 addressed to the редакція, Театральная ул. д. 2; the books will then be sent at once. Signed Секретарь редакціи (signature М. Пу...?).
why: exchange of publications; editorial office address

gist: Копія, № 62(?): the editor, sent on official business to Moscow from 2 to 4 September, asks for travel and daily allowances.
why: editor's trip to Moscow (same days as the photographer's commission)

gist: Исход. № 64: Князь С. М. Волконскій asks for copies of the Yearbook from the 1902-1903 season on, and did not receive the first issue under the present editor, posted to Rome. The artist В. А. Сѣровъ asks for a free copy from this year; Сѣровъ let the редакція reproduce his drawings (Н. А. Римскій-Корсаковъ and К. С. Станиславскій) shown last year at the Salon.
why: free copies for Volkonsky and Serov; Serov's portraits reproduced in the Yearbook

gist: Lower part of p.22 (overlap), same text to the end, 'Редакторъ'.
why: duplicate of p.22

gist: Копія, Исход. № 66: some artists of the Imperial Theatres asked to pay the subscription by instalments. Since the price rise made the Yearbook less accessible to people of small means, the editor proposes instalments of one ruble a month for artists and employees.
why: subscription price rise and instalment scheme

gist: Photo is upside down. End of the instalment proposal: to extend it also to all officials of state institutions, on their treasurers' guarantee; submitted to the Director. 'Редакторъ'.
why: continuation of the instalment scheme

from_to: Редакторъ -> Маріинскій Театръ, Н. Г. Сергѣеву
gist: № 69, on editorial letterhead: a second subscription sheet for the Yearbook has been sent to the BALLET troupe.
why: subscription sheet sent again to the ballet troupe

from_to: Редакція -> Счетный Отдѣлъ Конторы Московскихъ Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 71: sends two lists of people who subscribed to the Yearbook for 1909 by instalments and asks the accounts section to deduct the sums monthly from their pay and hand them to the editorial messenger against a receipt.
why: mechanics of instalment subscriptions in Moscow; the lists themselves are not here

gist: Lower part of p.27 (overlap) plus the last paragraph: by the Director's order instalments are allowed at one ruble a month. 'Редакторъ'.
why: duplicate of p.27; confirms the 1 ruble instalment

gist: On editorial letterhead: answering his letter of 18 Oct., the honorarium due to him was sent through the СПб. Главный Почтамтъ (postal receipt № 920) on 29 September to Moscow in his name; but the редакція had been given three addresses (continues p.32).
why: author's fee gone astray; contributor correspondence

gist: Lower part of p.29 (overlap); edges of other leaves visible at right.
why: duplicate of p.29

from_to: end of the letter to Александръ Ивановичъ (pp.29, 32-33)
gist: Close of the letter: if the answer is unsatisfactory the редакція will take every step to put the mistake right; it apologises again for its carelessness and the worry caused. 'Съ почтеніемъ редакція'. Faint.
why: end of the fee letter; no new facts

from_to: middle of the letter to Александръ Ивановичъ
gist: The three addresses given: 1) Зубовскій бульваръ, д. Дворцоваго Вѣдомства; 2) Общій архивъ Министерства Импер. Двора, Кремль, Троицкая башня; 3) Контора Императорскихъ театровъ. The редакція no longer knows to which the money went, only the postal receipt; asks him to enquire at the post office. Lower half faint.
why: identifies the paid contributor as a man at the Court Ministry archive in the Moscow Kremlin

gist: Lower part of p.32 (overlap) with the top of the next letter (p.34) showing beneath.
why: duplicate of p.32

gist: Исход. № 81: for the article «Оперный домъ» the honorarium due to him, 18 руб. less postage, was sent by transfer on 29 сентября 1909; a счетъ for that sum is enclosed for him to sign on receipt and return to the редакція Е. И. Т.
why: named article and fee: «Оперный домъ», 18 rubles

gist: Lower part of p.34 (overlap) with the signature: Секретарь редакціи М. Пу...? (same hand as p.20).
why: duplicate of p.34; secretary's signature

gist: Исход. № 82: fee notice to Липаевъ for his article «Обзоръ Московской оперы» — honorarium of 12 rubles, less postal costs, sent by transfer on 29 Sept.; he is asked to sign the enclosed счетъ and return it to the редакція. Edges of neighbouring leaves (№ 86, folio 21) intrude at right.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Named contributor, article title and fee amount

gist: Second photo (lower part) of p.36: same letter to Липаевъ about the 12-ruble fee for «Обзоръ Московской оперы», with the secretary's signature. Nothing new.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Duplicate of p.36 (contributor fee)

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Г. Директору Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 86: one-line request/subject «О командировкѣ сторожа на службу въ редакцію „Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ“» — asking that a watchman be assigned to the editorial office. The words «Николай Ефимовичъ» at top belong to the leaf underneath (p.39).
why: Editorial office staffing (watchman for the редакція)

from_to: Редакція Ежегодника (по распоряженію Г. Редактора) -> Николай Ефимовичъ [surname not on page; cf. p.48]
gist: Исход. № 87, on редакція letterhead (С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ): asks Николай Ефимовичъ to sign the enclosed счетъ for his article and return it to the редакція for forwarding to the Контора, so that his honorarium can be paid. Article not named here (p.48 names «Обзоръ Московской русской драмы»).
why: Contributor fee procedure; author addressed by name and patronymic

gist: Second photo (body text only) of p.39: request to sign and return the счетъ for his article so the Контора can pay the honorarium; «По распоряженію Г. Редактора».
why: Duplicate of p.39 (contributor fee)

gist: End of a letter (probably verso of folio 21, p.39): the редакція asks the addressee to send by transfer 6 руб. subscription money for the journal being sent to him. Signed by the секретарь редакціи.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Subscription price (6 руб.) charged to a contributor/addressee; no editorial content

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Постановочное Отдѣленіе
gist: Исход. № 93, on letterhead «Редакторъ Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ Баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ»: asks that the photographer of the Imperial Theatres be sent to the second dress rehearsal and the first performances of the plays «Ивановъ», «Тихая Пристань»(?) and «Звѣзда» to photograph the artists and sets.
why: Commissioning production photographs for the Yearbook; editor's letterhead

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Постановочное Отдѣленіе
gist: Исход. № 98(?): asks that the photographer be sent to photograph the artists in the play «Венеціанскій купецъ» on the 20th [month abbreviated, unclear] at 7½ in the evening. Right side of the photo is overlapped by folio 25 (№ 109, p.46).
why: Commissioning artist photographs for the Yearbook

gist: Mostly blank verso with heavy show-through; one short ink line, apparently a receipt note beginning «Получилъ …» with a name I could not read.
why: Near-blank verso; single unread note

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Контора Имп. Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 100: needing telephone communication with the Imperial Theatres, the editor asks the Контора to include him in the list of persons whom the city telephone administration is allowed to connect with the Imperial Theatres. Overlapped at right and top by other leaves.
why: Editor's working arrangements (telephone access to the theatres)

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Постановочное Отдѣленіе Конторы Имп. Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 109: asks that the photographer be sent to the Михайловскій театръ to photograph the artists of the French troupe on the evening of 3 ноября in the play «Zaza» and on Friday (daytime) 5 ноября in «Les demi-vierges»(?) (French title partly doubtful).
why: Commissioning photographs of the French troupe for the Yearbook

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Г. Управляющему Конторой Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 111: the editor states that clarifying certain questions touching the artistic and economic side of the «Ежегодникъ» requires his personal presence in Moscow, and asks to be sent there on official business at the end of this week or the beginning of next.
why: Editor's trip to Moscow on the Yearbook's artistic and economic affairs

from_to: Редакція Ежегодника -> Николай Ефимовичъ [surname not on page]
gist: Исход. № 112: informs Николай Ефимовичъ that for his article «Обзоръ Московской русской драмы», printed in the 3rd выпускъ, he is due an honorarium of 52 р. 50 коп.; by the editor's order 6 р. is deducted for his subscription to the Ежегодникъ for 1909 (receipt enclosed), together with a счетъ for the full sum. Continues on p.49.
why: Named article, issue number and fee amount for a contributor

gist: Lower part of p.48: repeats the 52 р. 50 коп. fee and 6 р. subscription deduction, then asks him to sign the счетъ and return it to the редакція (Театральная ул. д. 2); breaks off at «на пересылку». Strip of another leaf (folio 31, p.56) shows at the bottom.
why: Continuation of contributor-fee letter; редакція address

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Фотографія Московскихъ Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 115: needing figures for a report on income from subscriptions to the «Ежегодникъ», the editor asks the Moscow theatres' Photography to report by 18 Nov. the sums received for sale of the Ежегодникъ («подписку … отъ гг. артистовъ» struck out and replaced by «продажу»).
why: Sales revenue reporting; the theatre Photography acted as a sales point

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Фотографія С.П.Б. Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 116, on Дирекція letterhead: same request as p.50 to the St Petersburg theatres' Photography — report by 18 Nov. the sums received at the SPb theatres for sale of the «Ежегодникъ» (wording corrected from подписку to продажу; «отъ гг. артистовъ» struck out).
why: Sales revenue reporting for the editor's income report

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Фотографія С.П.Б. Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Second photo (lower part) of p.51, showing the same text plus the signature line «Редакторъ».
why: Duplicate of p.51 (sales revenue reporting)

from_to: Редакція Ежегодника (по распоряженію г. Редактора) -> Г. Булгаковъ
gist: Исход. № 117: encloses a subscription receipt for money received from Булгаковъ for the «Ежегодникъ» 1909 and informs him that выпуски I, II and III were sent to him on 14 November.
why: Routine subscriber correspondence; confirms issues I-III out by mid-Nov 1909

gist: Second photo (lower part) of p.53, same text with the secretary's signature.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Duplicate of p.53 (subscriber correspondence)

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Экипажное Заведеніе Дирекціи Импер. Театр.; Редакція -> редакція газеты «Одесскія Новости»
gist: Исход. № 121: asks the Carriage Establishment to release a бланкардъ (wagon) on the morning of 18 Nov. for the Ежегодникъ's needs — carting crates weighing 18 пудовъ from the Петербургская Сухопутная Таможня (contents of the crates not stated). Below, start of Исход. № 119 to «Одесскія Новости» (see p.56).
why: Crates (18 пудовъ) arriving through customs for the Yearbook — imported production material

gist: Исход. № 119: informs the newspaper «Одесскія Новости» that its 6 руб. subscription money has been received (receipt enclosed); all subsequent выпуски will be delivered as they come off the press, which will be announced in the newspapers. Margins show neighbouring leaves (Исход. 163-167).
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Newspaper as paying subscriber; 6 руб. subscription price; issues announced in the press

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Экипажное Заведеніе Дирекціи Импер. Театр.
gist: Full view of Исход. № 121 (see p.55): request for a бланкардъ on the morning of 18 Nov. to cart crates weighing 18 пудовъ from the Петербургская Сухопутная Таможня for the Ежегодникъ. Signed «Редакторъ».
why: Same as p.55: 18 пудовъ of crates through customs for the Yearbook

from_to: Редакція Ежегодника (по распоряженію г. Редактора) -> Николай Густавовичъ [surname not on page]
gist: Исход. № 123 or 125 (last digit unclear): informs Николай Густавовичъ that the 10 copies of the Ежегодникъ выпускъ III he asked for were sent by registered бандероль, 2 books in each, on 13 Nov. 1909; asks him to remit their cost (continues p.59).
why: Bulk order of 10 copies of issue III with per-copy price (see p.59)

gist: Continuation of p.58: cost reckoned at 1 руб. per book plus 3 руб. 80 коп. postage, total 13 рублей 80 коп., to be sent by transfer to the Редакція «Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ», Театральная ул. д. 2. Signed by the секретарь редакціи.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Price per issue (1 руб.) and postage figures for a 10-copy order

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Постановочное Отдѣленіе
gist: Исход. № 126: asks that the photographer be sent on Wednesday 2 December to the Михайловскій театръ to photograph the sets and the artists taking part in the evening performance of «Ифигенія» and «Эринніи».
why: Commissioning set and artist photographs for the Yearbook

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе
gist: Исход. № 127, replying to отношеніе № 2908: the Ежегодникъ reproduces mainly photographs of artists and sets of current Imperial Theatres productions, taken by the photographer К. А. Фишеръ; the artists whose sketches have been or will be printed are О. К. Аллегри, А. Я. Головинъ, К. А. Коровинъ, В. А. Сѣровъ, Стелецкій (initials doubtful) … (list continues on pp.62-63).
why: Editor's own statement of illustration policy: photographer Фишеръ and the named artists

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе
gist: Lower part of p.61, repeating the text and completing the list of artists: Аллегри, Головинъ, Коровинъ, Сѣровъ, Стелецкій, г. Ламбинъ, кн. А. К. Шервашидзе, В. А. Щуко, М. В. Добужинскій.
why: Full list of artists whose sketches the Yearbook prints

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе
gist: End of the letter of pp.61-62: these artists are in most cases decorators of the Imperial Theatres, or, like гг. Добужинскій and Щуко, work specially for the «Ежегодникъ»; the drawings they supply (watercolour, oil or pencil) usually show the same things as the photographs, i.e. costumes and sets. Signed «Редакторъ».
why: Добужинскій and Щуко working specially for the Yearbook; media and subjects of the drawings

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 152: asks the Контора to order the photographer to the Александринскій театръ tomorrow, 19 December, to photograph the artists in the play «Свѣтлая личность».
why: Commissioning artist photographs for the Yearbook

gist: Исход. № 153, on редакція letterhead (С.-Петербургъ, Итальянская ул., 1-8): informs an unnamed author that the счетъ he submitted for his article printed in № 4 of the «Ежегодникъ» has been presented in the usual way to the Хозяйственный комитетъ(?) of the Контора; once approved (in a few days) he will receive a талонъ for the sum. Author, article and amount not stated.
key_names: секретарь редакціи М. Бут…(?) (signature, surname not securely read)
why: Contributor fee procedure for an article in issue 4; new редакція address on letterhead

from_to: Редакція Ежегодника (по распоряженію г. Редактора) -> В. Сѣровъ
gist: Исход. № 159: informs В. Сѣровъ that all выпуски 1 through 4 of the «Ежегодникъ» have been sent to him in Moscow at the Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ; if that is inconvenient he is asked to give an address for delivery. Signature (secretary) not securely read.
why: Copies of issues 1-4 sent to the artist В. Сѣровъ, a named illustrator (p.61)

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Александринскій театръ; Маріинскій театръ (Опера); Маріинскій театръ (Балетъ); Михайловскій театръ (франц. драма); Московскій театръ (Опера)
gist: Исход. № 161: the editor forwards a subscription sheet for the «Ежегодникъ» «подъ моей редакціей» and asks that it be shown to the artists and that he be told who wishes to receive it. «Тоже самое» to the Маріинскій opera (№ 162), Маріинскій ballet (№ 163), Михайловскій French drama (№ 164), Moscow opera (№ 165).
why: Subscription drive among the troupes, including the Mariinsky ballet troupe; editor's initiative

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> troupes of the Imperial Theatres
gist: Lower part of p.67: the same subscription-sheet circular («Тоже самое») to the Маріинскій ballet (№ 163), Михайловскій French drama (№ 164), Moscow opera (№ 165), Moscow ballet (№ 166) and Moscow drama (№ 167).
why: Subscription sheets sent to the SPb and Moscow ballet troupes among others

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Г. Полиціймейстеру Маріинскаго Театра; Г. Полиціймейстеру Александринскаго Театра
gist: Исход. № 168: with the Дирекція's permission to distribute prospectuses of the «Ежегодникъ» in the auditorium of the Маріинскій театръ, the editor sends a number (left blank) of prospectuses and asks that they be laid out in the stalls and the boxes of the first two tiers, one per box and one per 2 seats, on the performances the полиціймейстеръ judges most interesting. № 169 begins: the same to the Александринскій.
why: Advertising: prospectuses laid on seats in the theatres, at the editor's request

from_to: Редакторъ (баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ) -> Полиціймейстеры Маріинскаго, Александринскаго и Михайловскаго Театровъ
gist: Lower part of p.69: end of the prospectus request (one per box and per 2 seats, most interesting performances), then «Тоже самое» to the Полиціймейстеръ of the Александринскій (№ 169) and of the Михайловскій театръ (№ 170); numbers of copies left blank.
why: Prospectus distribution in all three SPb theatres, at the editor's request

gist: Divider sheet headed «Исходящія бумаги за 1910 годъ»: start of the editorial office's outgoing-letter copies for 1910. Text of the next leaf shows through at the right edge.
why: section divider only

gist: End of a letter (its opening is not in this range): a stamp is enclosed, and the редакція will post the addressee 46 р. 25 коп., having deducted 25 коп. postal cost of the money transfer. Signed by the secretary of the редакція.
why: money remitted by the editorial office, but payee and purpose are not on this page

from_to: Редакторъ -> Г. Управляющій Конторой Императ. Театровъ
gist: Исход. № 1. The Director having permitted approaches to the relevant ministries about spreading the «Ежегодникъ» among school libraries, the editor asks the Kontora head to back the petition with copies of the 1909 issues published under his editorship, so the ministries have grounds to agree.
why: editor's own distribution campaign (school libraries) using the 1909 issues

gist: Исх. № 12. Forwards 4 copies of the «Ежегодникъ» to be attached to the official letters the Direction intends to send to Мин. Народ. Просв., Глав. Упр. Воен. Учеб. Завед., Учр. Импер. Маріи and Мин. Финансовъ about distributing the «Ежегодникъ».
why: distribution campaign to four ministries; no print/money figures

from_to: Редакторъ -> Г. Управляющій Конторою Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Исх. № 16. Asks that the artist Шарлемань (name hard to read) be admitted to the coming dress rehearsal of «Уріэль Акоста»; the Director has seen his drawings and has no objection to admitting him as a draughtsman (рисовальщикъ).
why: an artist sent to sketch a production, evidently for the Yearbook's illustrations

gist: № 17. To help spread the «Ежегодникъ», chiefly in the provinces, the editor asks leave to use five copies of the journal for free issue to persons who can further that aim; first among them a professor read as Ю. Н.(?) Перетцъ (text breaks off at foot of page).
why: editor asks for five free copies to allot to useful persons (provincial distribution)

gist: Исход. № 26. When out-of-town subscribers send money orders, the редакція has had the editor's signature certified in the Kontora's Регистратура with the Kontora seal; the Post Office now demands the редакція's own seal. Asks permission to institute a seal of the Редакція with the state arms in the centre.
why: editorial office gets its own seal; mechanics of receiving subscription money

gist: Lower part of the same leaf as p.77 (overlap): full text of the seal request down to the signature «Редакторъ»; the top of fol. 47 shows below.
why: same letter as p.77, complete to the end

gist: Исх. № 29. Hasty draft: the Kontora had sent the editor for guidance a list of institutions and persons receiving the «Ежегодникъ» free; on examining it he does not find in it those to whom free sending was specially authorised, namely (list follows on fol. 48). Asks the Kontora in future to bear this in mind / inform him.
why: dispute over the free-copy list; names are on the next leaf

gist: List headed «Была разрѣшена безплатная высылка журнала въ 1909 году»: Режиссерское Управленіе Императ. Московскаго Малаго Театра (рапортъ 20 Апрѣля 1909, № 821); А. В. Бельгардъ and Н. К. фонъ-Бооль (25 Апрѣля 1909, № 14); Ѳ. Д. Батюшковъ and П. О. Морозовъ (20 Мая 1909, № 24); художникъ В. А. Сѣровъ (4 Сентября 1909, № 64); художникъ профессоръ Штернъ? «въ Дрезденъ» (30 Сентября 1909, № 85); М. И. Струковъ? (by order of the Director, 10 Декабря 1909).
why: named recipients of free copies in 1909, incl. contributors (Батюшковъ, Морозовъ) and the artist Сѣровъ

gist: Исх. № 28. By report of 4 September last year the editor asked for furniture for the Редакція's premises (coat-rack, table, mirror, 2 chairs, a mat for the hall); only two chairs came. Asks for the rest or leave to buy it, charging the «Ежегодникъ»'s funds.
why: editorial office premises and their equipment, charged to Yearbook funds

gist: Lower part of fol. 49 (overlaps p.81) with the end of the furniture request: the purchase would come to roughly 25-30 руб. from the «Ежегодникъ»'s funds. Signed «Редакторъ».
why: gives the sum (25-30 руб.) for furnishing the editorial office

from_to: Редакторъ -> Въ Контору Императорскихъ Театр., Распорядительное Отдѣл.
gist: Исход. № 37(?). Forwards a complete copy of the «Ежегодникъ» for 1909 to be sent on to the Министерство Торговли и Промышленности at its request. Top of the photo shows part of fol. 51 underneath.
why: routine forwarding of one copy to a ministry

gist: Исх. 45. В. Н. Всеволодскій (Гернгроссъ), author of a work on theatrical education in Russia from the XVII c., has applied to the editor: by his own estimate XVII-XVIII cc. alone take about 34-35 printed sheets in the «Ежегодникъ»'s format and the XIX c. about 60-65 more, some 100 sheets in all. The editor understood the Director wished it printed as a supplement to the «Ежегодникъ» (continues).
why: major contents decision: whether to serialise Всеволодскій-Гернгроссъ's history of theatrical education as a supplement

gist: Lower part of fol. 51 (overlaps p.84) and further: without denying the merit of the work, the editor doubts the plan can be fully carried out under present conditions. Each issue holds 10-12 printed sheets of text, of which only 2-3 normally go to supplements, mostly plays of the current repertoire; all the rest must serve the contemporary theatre and chiefly the activity of the Imperial Theatres.
why: editor states the Yearbook's make-up: 10-12 sheets per issue, 2-3 for supplements

gist: Continuation of p.85: even at up to 3 sheets in every issue, XVII-XVIII cc. alone would take a year and a half of the publication (12 issues) and the XIX c. at least 3 more years. Such an allocation would return the journal to its original state before he became editor and stop the редакція, on the existing budget, from giving supplements more interesting to the wider public such as current plays. Turns to the financial question.
why: editor's argument about contents, budget and his own reform of the journal

gist: Lower part of fol. 51об: Всеволодскій says the sum granted him by the Director's order for working up the archival data is not to be counted against payment for printing, and that an honorarium of roughly 60(?) р. per printed sheet must come from the publication's own means. Printing one chapter would thus oblige the редакція to print all 100 sheets and make the publication his debtor for about 6000 р., printed in parts over 3-4 years.
why: author's fee: rate per printed sheet and c. 6000 р. total liability (figures should be re-read on the original)

gist: Исх. 46. Because of the «Ежегодникъ»'s transformation into a periodical(?) publication, the first issue under the new редакція came out not on 1 January 1909 but only in May; hence abnormal contract terms with the Управленіе Почтъ и Телеграфовъ, which took on posting it from 1 May 1909 to 1 May 1910. To bring issue into line with the calendar year the Управленіе requires a special declaration, draft enclosed.
why: dates the first issue under the new editor (May 1909) and the postal-distribution contract

gist: Lower part of fol. 52 (overlaps p.88): end of the letter, asking whether the Kontora could send the declaration on in its own name. «Редакторъ. См. на оборотѣ.»
why: same letter as p.88, closing lines

from_to: Контора С.П.Б. Императорскихъ Театровъ -> Въ Главное Управленіе почтъ и телеграфовъ
gist: Draft for the Kontora to send: asks that the редакція of the «Ежегодникъ», while still sending out the 1909 «Ежегодникъ» through the газетная экспедиція, be allowed to begin sending the first issues for 1910. In 1909 the subscription year was stated as 1 May to 1 May 1910; it is now changed to run 1 January 1910 to 1 January 1911.
why: subscription year changed to the calendar year; postal dispatch of 1909 and 1910 issues in parallel

gist: Исх. 66. For mailing the «Ежегодникъ»'s prospectuses the Главное Управленіе почтъ и телеграфовъ requires the Kontora's seal and each packet registered; after his talk with the Kontora head, the editor asks to be given the Kontora seal and a registration book for entering the packets.
why: mailing of subscription prospectuses; editor handles it himself

gist: Исх. 67. Hasty, heavily corrected draft: the редакція's office work is done by a single secretary paid 25 р. a month, who keeps the register of papers, the book-keeping, the current correspondence and the subscription lists (5 books mentioned). That sufficed while the «Ежегодникъ» appeared once a year; now the work has grown greatly (rest hard to read; continues overleaf).
why: staffing and pay of the editorial office: one secretary at 25 р. a month

gist: End of p.92, a few hastily written lines: apparently asks the Kontora to assign a clerk(?) to the редакція of the «Е. И. Т.» in addition to the secretary. Signed «Редакторъ». Reading uncertain; rest of leaf blank.
why: conclusion of the request for clerical help; cursive largely unreadable to me

from_to: Редакторъ -> Въ Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе С.П. Конторы Императорскихъ Театр.
gist: Исход. № 84(?; number overwritten). Forwards the 7 copies of the «Ежегодникъ Императорскихъ Театровъ» requested: 4 copies of issue 5 for 1909 and 3 copies of issue I for 1910.
why: routine supply of 7 copies to the Kontora

gist: № 97. By long-standing custom authors of articles printed in the «Ежегодникъ» receive offprints free. With issue VI-VII the drama «Шутъ Тантрисъ» by Э. Хардтъ was printed as a supplement in П. П. Потемкинъ's translation; the translator asked for offprints, but the printing house, by mistake, had put all the separate impressions of the play into the publication (continues on fol. 56об).
why: contributor's offprints; names the play supplement to issue VI-VII and its translator; printing-house error

gist: Second photo of fol. 56 (same letter as p.95, framed slightly lower): custom of free offprints for authors; Хардтъ's «Шутъ Тантрисъ» in Потемкинъ's translation as supplement to issue VI-VII.
why: duplicate of p.95

gist: End of the letter from p.95: «...ихъ выпусковъ. Въ виду сего» the editor asks the Kontora's permission to give г. Потемкинъ fifty copies of his play. Rest of leaf blank.
why: 50 copies of the play supplement granted to its translator in lieu of offprints

gist: Исх. № 102. Submits г. Энгель's account for 76 р. 50 к. paid him for the article «Золотой Пѣтушокъ» and asks the Kontora to refund the редакція. Explains that at Энгель's request the 1909 subscription price was set off against the fee, so 71 р. 25 к. was actually sent to him, as receipt № 938 shows.
why: author's fee: Энгель, article on the opera «Золотой Пѣтушокъ», 76 р. 50 к.

gist: Lower part of fol. 57 (overlaps p.98): full body of the Энгель fee letter (76 р. 50 к. for «Золотой Пѣтушокъ»; 71 р. 25 к. actually sent after deducting his 1909 subscription; receipt № 938) down to the signature «Редакторъ».
why: same letter as p.98, complete

gist: Исх. 107. Covering note: encloses the account of Ю. Озаровскій, paid by the редакція, for a book(?) of 1909 («за книгу 1909 г.»; one word uncertain). No sum given.
why: payment by the редакція to Ю. Озаровскій; purpose and amount not clear on this page

gist: Исход. № 122. Submits accounts totalling 185 р. 25 к. and asks the Kontora to return this sum to him; accounts №№ 42, 6 and 5, the money having been taken from the advance account (авансовый счетъ).
why: editorial expenses reimbursed from the advance account; no detail of what was bought

from_to: Редакція «Ежегодника» -> Въ Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе Конторы Импер. Т-овъ
gist: № 163. Reply to the Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе about remarks of the Контроль М-ва Импер. Двора (отзывъ of 26 Іюня, № 2469). Heavily corrected draft: the theatrical season spans two calendar years, so material collected at the start of a season is used at its end; thus in 1909 the «Ежегодникъ» received material used only in 1910 (continues overleaf).
why: editor answers the Court Ministry's audit of the Yearbook's accounts

from_to: Редакція «Ежегодника» -> Въ Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе Конторы Импер. Т-овъ
gist: Continuation of p.102, heavily corrected and hard to read: concerns a definite sum, mentioned as 2000 р., which the Контроль would carry to the 1910 estimate; the editor objects that the Дирекція gave no extra means for the following year, argues from seven issues in 1909 against eight due in 1910 (a figure «17 т. рублей»? appears), and asks the Хозяйственное Отдѣленіе to support him so no sum is charged against the 1910 credit.
why: budget figures for 1909/1910 and number of issues per year; needs the historian's own reading

from_to: Редакція «Ежегодника» -> Въ Постановочное Отдѣленіе Конт. Имп. Т-въ
gist: № 164. Asks the Постановочное Отдѣленіе to have the Photographer of the Imperial Theatres photograph the persons taking part in Островскій's comedy «Лѣсъ» (no artists named; text may continue below the frame).
why: commissioning cast photographs («Лѣсъ») for the Yearbook

from_to: Редакторъ -> Въ Постановочное отдѣленіе Конторы Импер. Т-въ
gist: Исх. 184(?). Asks the Постановочное Отдѣленіе to instruct the Фотографія Императорскихъ Театровъ to photograph as soon as possible the scenery of the opera «Миранда» by Казаченко.
why: commissioning photographs of opera scenery («Миранда») for the Yearbook

gist: The Chancellery of the Imperial Public Library asks the Редакція for issues 1 and 2 of 1910; at the same time the Helsingfors music journal «Tidning för Musik» proposes an exchange of publications. Editor asks the Director for instructions.
why: Free/exchange copies: library deposit and a foreign journal exchange

gist: Among those who previously received the Ежегодникъ free is Эдуардъ Александровичъ Старкъ, known in literature under the pseudonym «Зигфридъ»; Старкъ has asked whether the privilege continues, and the editor submits the question to the Director.
why: Free copy for a named theatre/music critic; reception side of distribution

gist: Editor proposes that, for wider circulation among the public, the Ежегодникъ be sold in railway kiosks (кіоски желѣзныхъ дорогъ) by agreement with the special agencies; submitted for the Director's decision.
why: Origin of the railway-kiosk sales idea named in the дело title; distribution only

gist: Intending to devote a special article to the Imperial Каменноостровскій Театръ, the editor asks the Контора to have the Фотографія Императорскихъ Театровъ photograph the theatre's exterior this autumn.
why: Planned article and commissioned photograph for the Yearbook

gist: For the coming Маріинскій театръ jubilee its exterior and interior must be photographed from various sides; the article on the theatre has been commissioned by the редакція from the architect В. Я. Курбатовъ, who should take part in the shoot by the Фотографія Императорскихъ Театровъ.
why: Names the commissioned author of the Mariinsky jubilee article and the photographs for it (Mariinsky = opera/ballet house, but ballet not mentioned)

gist: The Yearbook's contributor Н. Ф. Финдейзенъ (editor-publisher of the «Русская Музыкальная Газета») has been commissioned by the редакція to write a study of Russian vaudeville music; the editor asks that he be admitted to the Центральная and Нотная libraries of the Imperial Theatres to see the texts and music of vaudevilles and operas.
why: Named contributor and commissioned article (Russian vaudeville music); music history, not ballet

gist: Forwards a supplementary вѣдомость for receipt of the journal in 1910 and asks that six roubles be deducted by instalments from the subscriber named in it (name not given on this page).
why: Routine staff subscription by salary deduction (6 р.)

gist: Professor of the Нѣжинскій Институтъ В. И. Рѣзановъ sent the редакція three major works on Russian theatre history for review («Школьныя дѣйства XVII–XVIII вв. и театръ іезуитовъ», «Памятники русской драматической литературы», «Къ исторіи русской драмы») and asks in return for the Ежегодникъ of 1893–1894, 1894–1895 and 1897–1898 (приложенія, книги 2 и 3). Editor supports the request.
why: Exchange of back volumes/supplements for books sent for review

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (lower part of p.113, f.70)
gist: Lower part of the Рѣзановъ letter (same text as p.113) with its closing line asking the Director's consent and the signature line «Редакторъ».
why: Overlap of p.113

gist: Answering an inquiry of 28 Sept.: the sum of 3141 м. 60 pf. that the firm Georg Büxenstein mentions in its letter to the Director evidently relates to the редакція's debt for portraits supplied in 1909, already reported to the Кабинетъ Его Величества with a request to cover that year's overspend (передержка).
why: Cost of printed portraits from the Berlin firm Büxenstein and the 1909 budget overrun

gist: Answering an inquiry of 29 Sept.: the editor has no objection to renewing the contract with Е. Н. Целибѣевой(?) for the stitching/binding (брошюровка) of the Ежегодникъ on the previous terms.
why: Names the binder of the Yearbook and the renewal of her contract (surname reading doubtful)

gist: Forwards 26 copies of the Ежегодникъ, выпускъ 17-й for 1906–907, to be sent to the режиссерскія управленія of the Большой and Малый theatres for the artists, with lists of those who subscribed to that issue.
why: Distribution of 26 subscribed copies of the 1906-07 volume to Moscow artists

gist: The Нижегородская Губернская Ученая Архивная Коммиссія asked the Дирекція for the Ежегодникъ for its whole existence and for future issues; the editor supports this (continued on p.119).
why: Request for a complete run by a provincial learned society

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (lower part of p.118, f.74)
gist: Lower part of the same letter: editor asks that the grant be made conditional on an exchange, the Commission sending its Труды for all years to the Центральная Библіотека of the Imperial Theatres.
why: Overlap/continuation of p.118; exchange terms

gist: Reply to № 2957: sale of single issues of the Ежегодникъ in the foyers of the Imperial Theatres in 1909–10 brought 59 р. 20 к. in St Petersburg and 33 р. 10 к. in Moscow (not counting the 20% in favour of К. А. Фишеръ); nine subscriptions were also taken in Moscow (continued on p.121).
why: Actual revenue figures from the foyer-sales experiment and the seller's 20% commission

doc_type: draft letter, continuation of p.120 (overlapping view of f.75)
gist: Repeats the sales figures, then: Фишеръ explains the small results by a poor choice of sellers in the foyers — often no sale took place during performances, or copies were absent from the table. The editor asks the Контора to petition the Кабинетъ Его Императорскаго Величества again to allow sale of single issues and subscriptions in the St Petersburg and Moscow foyers.
why: Explanation of weak foyer sales and request to renew the permission; revenue figures

gist: Next year is the Маріинскій театръ jubilee; to illustrate the essay written for the occasion several photographs are needed, including the theatre's ceiling (плафонъ), and also photographs of drawings by Гваренги in the Imperial Hermitage chosen by the essay's author В. Я. Курбатовъ. Asks for orders to the Фотографія Императорскихъ Театровъ.
why: Illustration programme for Курбатовъ's Mariinsky jubilee essay

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (lower part of p.122, f.76)
gist: Same text as p.122 (body and signature line «Редакторъ»), without the heading.
why: Overlap of p.122

gist: Asks that the Фотографія Императорскихъ Театровъ photograph the chandeliers, candelabra and furniture of the production of «Донъ-Жуанъ» at the Александринскій театръ, and also photograph the performers in two French plays at the Михайловскій театръ (titles in Latin script, read doubtfully as «L'amiral»? and «Rubicon»?). No artist is named.
why: Commissioning production and artist photographs for the Yearbook (drama; the two French titles need the historian's eye)

gist: Only a subject line: «О составленіи обзора дѣятельности учрежденій обслуживающихъ Императорскіе Театры» — on compiling a survey of the work of the institutions serving the Imperial Theatres; the text itself is not copied.
why: A contents decision: a planned survey section; text not given

gist: Extract from Хозяйственный Комитетъ resolution № 213: item 47, the editor's advance account (№ 846) for 484 р. 57 к. is passed for execution except bill № 1 (А. Каль), which belongs to 1909. Signed В. Чагинъ, Л. Медеръ, П. Шенкъ.
why: Editorial office accounts: advance account of 484 р. 57 к.

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (lower part of p.126, f.79)
gist: Lower part of the same extract: signatures and the handwritten forwarding note sending it to the editor, Baron Дризенъ.
why: Overlap of p.126 (editor's advance account); names Дризенъ as editor

from_to: С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ, Отдѣленіе Хозяйственное -> Редакторъ «Ежегодника»
gist: Recalls that by letter of 4 Sept. 1909 (№ 2699) the Контора reported the Кабинетъ Его Императорскаго Величества's permission, as a one-year experiment, to sell single issues of the Ежегодникъ and take subscriptions in the foyers of the St Petersburg and Moscow Imperial Theatres (continued on p.129).
why: The foyer-sales experiment: terms and date of the permission

gist: …at the tables where the artists' photographs are sold. The term having expired, the Контора asks for a prompt report on the results of the experiment. Signed Управляющій Конторою А. Крупенскій, his assistant Чагинъ and the дѣлопроизводитель.
why: Foyer sales alongside the artists' photographs; request for results (answered on pp.120-121)

from_to: Кабинетъ Его Императорскаго Величества, Отдѣлъ Хозяйственный -> Дирекція Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Copy: with the approval of the acting head of the Кабинетъ, there is no objection to allowing in future the sale of single issues of the Ежегодникъ and subscriptions in the foyers of the Imperial Theatres in St Petersburg and Moscow (text continues/repeats on p.131).
why: Permanent permission for foyer sales and subscriptions

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (lower part of p.130, f.81)
from_to: Кабинетъ Его Императорскаго Величества -> Дирекція Императорскихъ Театровъ; forwarded to Редакторъ «Ежегодника» Баронъ Н. В. Дризенъ
gist: Full text of the Cabinet's permission for foyer sales, signed Рюдманъ and Ларіоновъ; handwritten note forwards the copy for information to the editor, Baron Н. В. Дризенъ.
